response.sql: WITH color_totals AS (SELECT p.product_color, SUM(ili.derived_total_cost) AS invoiced_amount FROM Invoice_Line_Items AS ili JOIN Products AS p ON p.product_id = ili.product_id GROUP BY p.product_color), color_average AS (SELECT AVG(invoiced_amount) AS average_per_color, SUM(invoiced_amount) AS total_invoiced FROM color_totals) SELECT AVG(ct.invoiced_amount) AS average_invoiced_amount, AVG(ct.invoiced_amount * 1.0 / NULLIF(ca.total_invoiced, 0)) AS average_share, AVG(ct.invoiced_amount - ca.average_per_color) AS average_amount_above_per_color_average FROM color_totals AS ct CROSS JOIN color_average AS ca WHERE ct.invoiced_amount > ca.average_per_color;
